description: Unofficial Aigis fan art from Persona 3. Original-form Aigis performs servo-like finger and wrist checks, balances and recovers a paper crane, crouches to inspect a harmless foam nut, takes a controlled low hop and walks in three articulated directions. Opaque white joint infills, compact neutral proportions and smooth nonweapon wrist cuffs are explicit adaptations; no guns or display stand.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
